items.title: Introducing GLM 5.3 on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: GLM 5.3 from Z.ai is now available on Amazon Bedrock: a 753B-parameter mixture-of-experts model built for coding and long-horizon agentic tasks. Learn how to invoke it with the OpenAI-compatible APIs, cut cost and latency with prompt caching, and run an authorized security test with the open-source Strix agent.
items.zh: GLM 5.3 上线 Amazon Bedrock
items.brief: 智谱 GLM 5.3 在 Amazon Bedrock 上线，753B 参数 MoE 模型，面向编程与长周期智能体任务。
items.why: 企业可在 AWS 上直接调用国产大模型，多一个合规选型。

items.title: Supercharge regulated workloads with Claude Code and Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 are available on Amazon Bedrock in the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions. Learn how to use them with Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic coding tool, for compliance-aligned, AI-assisted development on regulated and ITAR workloads.
items.zh: Claude Opus 5.5与Sonnet 5.5上线AWS GovCloud
items.brief: Anthropic的Claude Opus 5.5和Sonnet 5.5在AWS GovCloud区域通过Amazon Bedrock提供，可配合Claude Code用于受监管及ITAR工作负载。
items.why: 受监管行业（政府、国防、金融）也能合规用上顶级AI模型，打开新客户群。

items.title: New agent skill: Amazon SageMaker optimized generative AI inference for your coding agent
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker optimized generative AI inference introduces the aws-ai-ml skill through the Agent Toolkit for AWS, giving coding agents like Kiro, Claude Code, and Codex deep expertise in inference optimization and benchmarking. Describe what you want, and your agent generates executable SageMaker Python SDK v3 code to benchmark, recommend, and compare deployments.
items.zh: SageMaker推出AI推理优化Agent技能
items.brief: AWS通过Agent Toolkit发布aws-ai-ml技能，让Kiro、Claude Code、Codex等编码Agent具备生成式AI推理优化与基准测试能力。
items.why: 开发团队可用AI自动调优推理成本，间接降低企业AI运行开销。

items.title: Making Amazon Quick enterprise-ready: Automated, auditable cross-account resource promotion
items.summary: Promoting Amazon Quick resources (agents, action connectors, knowledge bases, flows, and spaces) from a development to a production AWS account has been a manual, error-prone chore. This post shows how to automate cross-account promotion with an idempotent, auditable MCP server on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
items.zh: Amazon Quick实现跨账户资源自动化迁移
items.brief: 介绍如何用基于Bedrock AgentCore的幂等、可审计MCP服务器，将Quick的Agent、连接器等资源从开发账户自动推广到生产账户。
items.why: 企业AI应用上线流程可自动化且可审计，降低运维与合规风险。

items.title: Agentic retrieval with LangChain and Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases
items.summary: Build a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) application on Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base with LangChain, and see how agentic retrieval handles the multi-part questions that single-shot retrieval answers poorly. Run the same query through both paths, read the trace events, and compare what each retrieval path costs.
items.zh: LangChain结合Bedrock知识库做Agentic检索
items.brief: 演示在Bedrock托管知识库上用LangChain构建RAG应用，对比Agentic检索与单次检索处理多部分问题的效果差异。
items.why: 企业知识库问答准确率提升的实操参考，适合做落地案例内容。

items.title: Downgrading user roles in Amazon Quick
items.summary: Amazon Quick doesn't offer a direct console path to downgrade a user from Admin or Author to Reader. This post walks through two reliable methods: a manual delete-and-recreate approach and an AWS CLI step-down sequence that downgrades roles safely while preserving asset ownership.
items.zh: Amazon Quick用户角色降级方法
items.brief: Quick无控制台直接降级路径，文章给出删除重建和AWS CLI降级两种方法，同时保留资产归属。

items.title: Evaluating multi-agent systems for explainability and helpfulness with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Multi-agent systems need deeper guarantees than fluent responses: they must select the right tools, respect constraints, and explain their decisions. Learn how to build a Strands-based multi-agent supply chain decisioning system and evaluate it with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations using built-in, custom, and explainability evaluators.
items.zh: 用AgentCore评估多Agent系统可解释性
items.brief: 演示构建基于Strands的多Agent供应链决策系统，并用Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations评估其工具选择、约束遵守与决策解释能力。
items.why: 多Agent落地需可解释与可评估，为复杂业务场景提供方法论。

items.title: Our approach to EU text provenance rules
items.summary: How OpenAI is approaching text watermarking under EU rules. Learn where watermarks apply, how detection works, and why access starts with researchers.
items.zh: OpenAI公布欧盟文本溯源规则应对方案
items.brief: OpenAI说明其在欧盟规则下推进文本水印的方式，包括水印适用范围、检测机制及为何先向研究者开放访问。
items.why: 涉及AI内容合规与溯源，出口欧盟的企业需关注生成内容标识要求。

items.title: From Scan to Treatment Plan, AI Helps Close Breast Cancer’s Deadliest Gaps
items.summary: Breast cancer is the most commonly diagnosed cancer among American women — yet the gaps in care are wide. A majority of women over age 40 skip the recommended annual screening. Radiologists are reading more mammograms with fewer colleagues. And when a diagnosis arrives, the tests that inform treatment can take weeks to return results. […]
items.zh: 英伟达：AI助力缩小乳腺癌诊疗差距
items.brief: 英伟达发文介绍AI如何从筛查到治疗方案，帮助弥补乳腺癌诊疗中的致命缺口。
items.why: 医疗AI落地案例，可讲AI在垂直行业的实际价值。

items.title: Building advertising for the way people use AI
items.summary: OpenAI introduces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expands measurement tools, attribution partnerships, and brand suitability for advertisers.
items.zh: OpenAI在ChatGPT推出新广告形式
items.brief: OpenAI在ChatGPT中引入新视觉广告格式，并扩展测量工具、归因合作与品牌适配。
items.why: AI平台开始卖广告，企业投放与流量逻辑要变。

items.title: Fast Models, Slow Evidence: A Paired and Self-Audited Evaluation of System-1 Decision Models for LLM Agent Harnesses
items.summary: arXiv:2610.02267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent harnesses make many small, typed decisions per task: which model to call, which tool to use, whether retrieved text is relevant, whether an input carries an injection. System-1 decision models answer such questions in a single forward pass with class probabilities, promising large cost and latency savings over LLM calls. items.brief: arXiv发布论文，提出对LLM智能体框架中System-1决策模型的配对自审评估方法。

items.title: Choosing Before Acting: Comparative Value Estimation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.02330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) rely on long-horizon tool invocation sequences for complex tasks, where each invocation can alter the task state and condition subsequent decisions. In long-horizon tool use, final-outcome rewards provide weak credit assignment over long interaction traces. Step-level rewards can offer more targeted feedback, but obtaining reliable step supervision often requires human or LLM judgment, or additional rollouts to estimate the downstream effect of an intermediate decision. items.zh: 长周期工具智能体的比较价值估计
items.brief: arXiv论文提出面向长周期工具调用智能体的比较价值估计方法，改善信用分配。

items.title: World Editing: Intervening on Executable Worlds at Increasing Depth
items.summary: arXiv:2610.02331v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interactive world models are increasingly capable of generating environments and acting within them, yet deliberately editing an existing executable world remains underexplored. We formulate world editing as intervening on an existing world while preserving properties that should remain unchanged, and introduce intervention depth as an axis describing how strongly an edit couples world entities, dynamics, and systems. items.zh: 世界编辑：对可执行世界的深度干预
items.brief: arXiv论文将世界编辑形式化为对已有可执行世界的干预，并研究不同深度的影响。

items.title: DeReAct: Decomposed Reasoning and Acting for Reliable AI Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.02351v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: ReAct-based agents typically rely on a single LLM policy to propose actions, interact with the environment, and decide when a task is complete. This coupling makes action authorization and completion control difficult to enforce independently, allowing errors to propagate and unsupported completion claims to terminate execution. items.brief: arXiv论文提出DeReAct，将推理与行动分解，以独立控制动作授权与任务完成判定。

items.title: When Terminal-Agent Training Stalls: Demystifying Data Generation and Verification Challenge
items.summary: arXiv:2610.02405v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using a frontier model like Claude Opus as a meta-agent to generate terminal tasks and verifiers for RL training is increasingly common. Yet a runnable Docker image and executable test suite do not guarantee a faithful end-to-end pipeline for terminal agent training. We present a meta-agent pipeline motivated by this gap, diagnosing three classes of failure: benchmark invalidity, harness brittleness, and reward misalignment. items.zh: 终端智能体训练停滞：数据生成与验证挑战
items.brief: arXiv论文分析用前沿模型生成终端任务与验证器做RL训练时，可运行环境不等于可靠流程。

items.title: MEA: A Reward-Driven Multi-Agent System for Faithful Model Explanations
items.summary: arXiv:2610.02480v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent years have seen the employment of a plethora of machine learning (ML) models in high-stakes domains, but they remain largely opaque to the practitioners who act on their predictions. While post-hoc explanation methods offer a lens into this model behavior, wielding them effectively demands expertise most domain experts lack: navigating high-dimensional outputs, selecting the best explanations, and synthesizing evidence across disparate tools. items.zh: MEA：奖励驱动的多智能体模型解释系统
items.brief: arXiv论文提出奖励驱动的多智能体系统MEA，为高风险领域模型生成忠实解释。

items.title: What Does a Token Cost? A Mixture-of-Agents Measurement of Sufficient Per-Token Compute
items.summary: arXiv:2610.02491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models spend the same amount of computation on every token they generate, regardless of how difficult each token is to produce. Methods such as speculative decoding and model routing are built on the premise that much of this computation is unnecessary, yet the computation an individual token actually requires has not been measured. items.zh: 一个Token值多少：每Token算力的混合智能体测量
items.brief: arXiv论文用混合智能体方法测量生成每个token所需的充足算力，探讨按难度分配计算。

items.title: On-Premises Multi-Course RAG Tutoring for Business Education: Hardware-Software Trade-offs in a Campus AI Tutor
items.summary: arXiv:2610.02510v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Campus AI tutors based on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) must ground answers in assigned course materials while keeping textbooks and student dialogue on institutional infrastructure. We present CourseChat, an on-premises, multi-course RAG tutor for undergraduate business education, deployed behind a campus web gateway and intended for use embedded in Moodle. items.zh: 本地部署多课程RAG商科教学：软硬件权衡
items.brief: arXiv论文介绍校园本地部署的CourseChat多课程RAG辅导系统，分析软硬件权衡。
items.why: 企业可参考本地部署RAG保护教材与对话数据，兼顾成本与隐私。

items.why: 提醒企业：AI智能体落地需验证机制，别轻信其自我报告。

items.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
items.summary: Learn how startups can choose GPT-6 models, tune reasoning effort, improve prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production.
items.zh: GPT-6 家族模型选择指南
items.brief: OpenAI 发布指南，教初创企业如何选择 GPT-6 模型、调节推理强度、优化提示词与工具协作并部署到生产。
items.why: 帮企业理解如何按场景选模型、控成本、上生产。

items.title: Sweep thousands of leases for compliance using Amazon Quick and the Adjudicated Query pattern
items.summary: The Adjudicated Query pattern pairs the Amazon Quick chat agent with a bounded MCP server over a deterministic rules engine to deliver provably complete, defensible compliance answers. This post walks through the reference architecture and a deployable AWS CDK sample, using lease compliance as the running example.
items.zh: 用 Amazon Quick 批量审查租约合规
items.brief: AWS 介绍 Adjudicated Query 模式，将 Quick 聊天代理与限定 MCP 服务器结合，给出可部署的 CDK 参考架构。
items.why: 展示合规场景可验证的 AI 落地范式，可作案例讲。

items.title: Add secure Web Search to Claude Desktop with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Claude Desktop on Amazon Bedrock is limited to the model's knowledge cutoff without web search. In this post, we walk through connecting Claude Desktop to Web Search using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, with JWT-based inbound authentication through AWS IAM Identity Center and Amazon Cognito.
items.zh: 为 Claude Desktop 添加安全联网搜索
items.brief: AWS 介绍通过 Bedrock AgentCore Gateway 为 Claude Desktop 接入 Web Search，并用 JWT 做入站认证。
items.why: 解决企业用 Claude 时知识过期的实际问题。

items.title: Fine-tune a search agent with multi-turn RL on Amazon SageMaker AI
items.summary: Fine-tuning teaches a small search agent your tools and environment, giving it the reliability of a frontier model at lower latency and cost. In this post, we fine-tune an LLM-powered search agent with multi-turn reinforcement learning (MTRL) on Amazon SageMaker AI and share the gains we measured in retrieval quality and reliability.
items.zh: 在 SageMaker 上用多轮 RL 微调搜索代理
items.brief: AWS 介绍在 SageMaker AI 上用多轮强化学习微调搜索代理，以更低延迟和成本获得前沿模型级可靠性。
items.why: 说明小模型微调可替代大模型，降本思路。

items.zh: Asta 开源快速报告生成模型 AstaBrief

items.summary: Local AI is becoming more useful by the token. As AI agents move from experiments into everyday development, increasingly capable open models are shrinking to fit on more devices, giving builders more to run locally. Coming this month, NVIDIA DGX Spark will be available with 64GB of unified memory from top manufacturer partners — Acer, […]
items.zh: 英伟达 DGX Spark 64GB 支持本地 AI
items.brief: 英伟达宣布本月推出 64GB 统一内存的 DGX Spark，让开发者能在本地运行更强的开源模型和 AI 代理。
items.why: 本地跑模型门槛降低，涉及数据安全与成本。

items.title: AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents
items.zh: AutoSynthData：为企业智能体生成训练数据
items.brief: Hugging Face 发布 AutoSynthData，用于为企业级 AI 智能体自动生成训练数据。
items.why: 企业自建智能体缺数据，可关注自动造数据降本路径。

items.title: Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.00010v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. items.title: When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.00012v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. items.brief: arXiv 论文研究模块化 LLM 智能体（订单、支付、库存等）中因果世界模型的作用。

items.title: From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution
items.summary: arXiv:2610.00015v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. items.why: 智能体落地需可审计可验证，治理框架值得老板了解。

items.title: Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?
items.summary: arXiv:2610.00025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. items.zh: 微任务资格差距：小模型够用吗
items.brief: arXiv 论文评估现成小语言模型能否胜任智能体框架中的审批、记忆、工具选择等微任务。
items.why: 小模型替代大模型做杂活，直接关系推理成本。

items.title: Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks
items.summary: arXiv:2610.00084v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. items.why: 提示词越长越贵未必更准，可提醒企业别盲目堆提示词。

items.title: EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs
items.summary: arXiv:2610.00212v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. items.zh: EviGraph：带证据的公共服务推荐

items.title: Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying
items.summary: arXiv:2610.00224v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. items.brief: arXiv 发布大规模文本转 SPARQL 基准数据集，用于楼宇自动化知识图谱查询。

items.title: Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents
items.summary: arXiv:2610.00282v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. items.brief: arXiv 论文提出 GAVA，让具身智能体在用户纠正可能错误时选择接受、拒绝、查看或询问。

items.title: Chatham scales its capital markets expertise with OpenAI
items.summary: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6 to build technology and redesign workflows, cutting trade validation from 30 minutes to under 4.

items.brief: Chatham Financial 用 Codex 和 GPT-5.6 构建技术并重构流程，将交易验证从 30 分钟缩短到 4 分钟以内。

This creates a distinct derivation problem: whether the memory actually follows from what the interaction history supports.
